name: local-latex-ocr
title: Local LaTeX OCR
description: Capture a printed equation and convert it to LaTeX entirely on your Mac.
author: do_nhat_minh

commands.name: capture-math
commands.title: Capture Math
commands.description: Capture a printed equation as raw LaTeX

commands.name: capture-math-markdown
commands.title: Capture Math as Markdown
commands.description: Capture a printed equation wrapped in inline Markdown math delimiters

commands.name: capture-display-math
commands.title: Capture Display Math
commands.description: Capture a printed equation wrapped in display Markdown math delimiters

commands.name: review-last-capture
commands.title: Review Last Capture
commands.description: Review, edit, and paste the latest OCR result

preferences.name: pasteAutomatically
preferences.title: Output
preferences.description: Paste recognized LaTeX into the previously focused application
preferences.label: Paste Automatically

preferences.name: copyToClipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.description: Keep recognized LaTeX on the clipboard
preferences.label: Copy to Clipboard

preferences.name: alwaysShowPreview
preferences.title: Review
preferences.description: Open the review screen before delivering every result
preferences.label: Always Show Preview

scripts.build: npm run build:worker && ray build -e dist
